name: @jskit-ai/auth-provider-local-core
description: Local auth provider with a file backend default, no database requirement, and optional Google, Microsoft and GitHub sign-in.

surfaces.summary: Provides the selected local authentication service through explicit runtime capabilities.

Exports the local auth service and its configuration (createLocalAuthService, resolveLocalAuthConfig), the file backend, the password strategy helpers (scryptPasswordStrategy, normalizePasswordStrategy, hashPassword, verifyPassword), the logged recovery and confirmation senders (createLoggedRecoverySender, createLoggedConfirmationSender), the first account's setup code (createFirstAccountSetup, SETUP_CODE_FILE, SETUP_CODE_ENV), the logged second factor events (createLoggedSecondFactorEvents), and local auth register hook decorators. Google, Microsoft and GitHub sign-in turn on from AUTH_GOOGLE_*, AUTH_MICROSOFT_* and AUTH_GITHUB_* client id and secret pairs.

Types of the auth.local.backend contract (AuthLocalBackend) that every local auth backend implements, of the auth.local.password-strategy, auth.local.recovery-sender, auth.local.confirmation-sender, auth.local.confirmation-mode, auth.local.second-factor-events and auth.local.pass-identity capabilities, and of the configuration, passwords and sessions local auth's modules share.
